triples.tail_surface: interchange any two of the three phase wires
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 交换三相电机任意两根相线
triples.evidence_text: If rotation is incorrect on a three-phase motor, have a qualified electrician interchange any two of the three phase wires to change direction.

triples.head_surface: pump fails to prime within five minutes
triples.tail_surface: check the suction line for leaks
triples.evidence_text: If the pump fails to prime within five minutes, stop it and check the suction line for leaks.

triples.tail_surface: No leakage should be visible at pump mating surfaces, or at pump connections or fittings
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 目视检查泵接合面及连接件无泄漏
triples.evidence_text:
Leakage
No leakage should be visible at pump mating surfaces, or at pump connections or fittings.

triples.tail_surface: Keep all line connections and fittings tight
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 保持所有管路连接和接头紧固
triples.evidence_text: Keep all line connections and fittings tight to maintain maximum pump efficiency.

triples.tail_surface: liquid could come to a boil, build pressure, and cause the pump casing to rupture or explode
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 液体沸腾升压导致泵壳破裂或爆炸
triples.evidence_text: Overheating can occur if operated with the valves in the suction or discharge lines closed. Operating against closed valves could bring the liquid to a boil, build pressure, and cause the pump to rupture or explode.

triples.tail_surface: stop the pump and allow it to cool before servicing it. Refill the pump casing with cool liquid
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 停泵冷却后再维修并向泵壳注入冷液
triples.evidence_text: If overheating occurs, stop the pump and allow it to cool before servicing it. Refill the pump casing with cool liquid.

triples.tail_surface: Allow an over-heated pump to completely cool before servicing
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 过热泵完全冷却后再维修
triples.evidence_text: Allow an over-heated pump to completely cool before servicing.
